parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the O&M window.

- **true**: Enabled.
- **false**: Disabled.

parameters.name: PlanWindowName
parameters.description: The name of the O&M window. You can specify a custom name. The name can be up to 200 characters in length.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call DescribeRegions to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: SupportMaintenanceAction
parameters.description: The O&M operations supported by the O&M window.

parameters.name: TargetResource
parameters.description: The resources on which the O&M window takes effect.

parameters.name: TimePeriod
parameters.description: The recurring cycle of the O&M window.
